workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Tool-output file uploads fail with EACCES because scratch files are written into the installed package (dist/.tmp)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(uploads): stage outgoing documents in the OS temp directory. Target files: src/bot/events/telegram-event-delivery.ts, tests/bot/events/telegram-event-delivery.test.ts. `TelegramEventDelivery.sendDocument()` now stages the outgoing document under `os.tmpdir()/opencode-telegram-bot` instead of `<installed package>/dist/.tmp`. (Ref: https://github.com/grinev/opencode-telegram-bot/pull/287)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: /task schedule parsing fails when server default model cannot be resolved (LM Studio model IDs)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(scheduled-tasks): pass selected model to schedule parser prompt. Target files: src/app/services/scheduled-task-schedule-parser-service.ts, src/bot/commands/task-command.ts, tests/app/services/scheduled-task-schedule-parser-service.test.ts. `/task` schedule parsing fails whenever the OpenCode server cannot resolve its *default* model, because the temporary schedule-parser session is the only prompt path in the bot that does not pass a model explicitly. (Ref: https://github.com/grinev/opencode-telegram-bot/pull/234)

workarounds.symptom: Models with long IDs in recent crash /models menu with BUTTON_DATA_INVALID (Telegram 64-byte callback_data limit)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(model): keep callback data short. Target files: src/bot/callbacks/model-selection-callback-handler.ts, src/bot/menus/inline-menu.ts, src/bot/menus/model-selection-menu.ts. - keep `/models` favorite/recent callbacks short by using list references instead of embedding provider/model IDs - keep model search result callbacks short by storing the selected models in interaction metadata - add regression coverage for long Fireworks-style model IDs that exceed Telegram callback_data limits (Ref: https://github.com/grinev/opencode-telegram-bot/pull/179)

workarounds.symptom: Scheduled tasks fail daily: premature giveup during session startup deletes the session (FOREIGN KEY constraint failed)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(scheduled-task): wait for session startup before giving up. Target files: src/app/services/scheduled-task-executor-service.ts, tests/app/services/scheduled-task-executor-service.test.ts. `waitForScheduledTaskResult` treated a session that is **not yet in the status map** (server has not started processing the prompt) the same as a session that has gone **idle**: (Ref: https://github.com/grinev/opencode-telegram-bot/pull/165)
